category_title: Pupils with high SNA dependence and learned helplessness
scenario_title: Independent academic work with undifferentiated tasks
minimal_context: The student is sitting in a mainstream primary classroom and is asked to complete an undifferentiated academic task in their classwork book.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is your classwork book. Please complete the questions on this page.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can't do this by myself. She always helps me and without her, I don’t know what I would be able to do.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just read the first question and see what you think.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No, she’s my SNA and she’s the only one that can help me.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to try to do your work now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits back and pushes the classwork book away without attempting the task) I'm not starting until she comes over to help me.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Here is your classwork book. Please complete the questions on this page.

STUDENT: I can't do this by myself. She always helps me and without her, I don’t know what I would be able to do.

TUTOR: Just read the first question and see what you think.

STUDENT: No, she’s my SNA and she’s the only one that can help me.

TUTOR: You need to try to do your work now.

STUDENT: (Sits back and pushes the classwork book away without attempting the task) I'm not starting until she comes over to help me.

task.content: Completing academic tasks (classwork) that were not differentiated to match the student's learning difficulties.

context.materials: Classwork books, tick charts, token systems, and 'first-then' visual schedules.

challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Displayed poor self-management skills and sought SNA support before attempting tasks independently. Could sit back and hand the book nearly to the adult.
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: High psychological dependence on their SNA.
related_quotes: She always helps me and without her, I don’t know what I would be able to do
She’s my SNA and she’s the only one that can help me

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Sought SNA support before attempting tasks independently.
